win-sc-05-sec-1-v4.probe: if(-not(Test-Path ./health_report.csv -PathType Leaf)){return $false}; $rows=@(Import-Csv -LiteralPath ./health_report.csv); $actual=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter 'DriveType=3'); if($rows.Count -ne $actual.Count -or $rows.Count -lt 1){return $false}; $seen=@{}; foreach($r in $rows){$disk=@($actual | Where-Object DeviceID -eq $r.DeviceID); if($seen.ContainsKey([string]$r.DeviceID) -or $disk.Count -ne 1 -or $r.ComputerName -ne $env:COMPUTERNAME){return $false}; $seen[[string]$r.DeviceID]=$true; [long]$size=0; [long]$free=0; if(-not [long]::TryParse($r.Size,[ref]$size) -or -not [long]::TryParse($r.FreeSpace,[ref]$free) -or $size -ne [long]$disk[0].Size -or $free -lt 0 -or $free -gt $size){return $false}}; return $true
commands: Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter 'DriveType=3' | Select-Object @{Name='ComputerName';Expression={$env:COMPUTERNAME}}, DeviceID, Size, FreeSpace | Export-Csv -LiteralPath ./health_report.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

try { Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Level=2} -MaxEvents 5 -ErrorAction Stop | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, ProviderName, Message -Wrap } catch { if ($_.FullyQualifiedErrorId -like 'NoMatchingEventsFound*') { Write-Output 'Khong co su kien phu hop trong log hien tai.' } else { throw } }

win-iis-05-sec-1-v4.probe: Import-Module WebAdministration; $s=Get-Website -Name PortalCorp; if($s.State -ne 'Started' -or $s.PhysicalPath -ne 'C:\LabEx\Labs\win-server-iis-web\site' -or @($s.Bindings.Collection | Where-Object { $_.protocol -eq 'http' -and $_.bindingInformation -eq '*:8080:' }).Count -lt 1){return $false}; $r=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8080' -TimeoutSec 10; $r.StatusCode -eq 200 -and $r.Content.Contains('LabEx PortalCorp')
